source.title_or_context: **Table 2.** Suggestions for HF Clinicians When Screening for Nutritional Inadequacies and Deficiencies

table_assessment.assessment_notes: The two-part structured table mixes clinician-facing assessment suggestions and one explicit recommendation against vitamin-D screening with descriptive signs, thresholds, tool properties, and biomarker associations. Assertion-bearing cells are retained separately, but row-level modality is mixed and therefore not immediately evaluation-ready.

factual_relations.notes: The source uses 'can indicate'; no causal claim is made.
The source uses 'can indicate'; no causal claim is made.

text_units.verbatim_text: Medical history and disease chronicity can indicate the likelihood of malnutrition and inflammation

normative_assertions.notes: The table is explicitly framed as clinician suggestions, and this cell gives an imperative history-assessment action followed by examples.

text_units.verbatim_text: Identify malabsorption history: previous gastrointestinal surgery, including bariatric surgery or bowel resection, gastrointestinal symptoms, including ageusia (loss of taste), dysgeusia (distorted taste), or anorexia (loss of appetite), nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, dysphagia; dental health; history of aspiration events; history of diabetes and gastroparesis; medication history, including allergies, herbs, and supplements; social history, including food insecurity due to finances, assistance required with activities of daily living (shopping, cooking, eating), ethnic or social dietary preferences, substance abuse

physical signs specific to micronutrient deficiencies

text_units.verbatim_text: Wasting of subcutaneous fat and/or skeletal muscle; physical signs specific to micronutrient deficiencies

factual_relations.notes: The source says the nail lines suggest hypoalbuminemia; association, not causality, is recorded.

text_units.verbatim_text: Cachexia: loss of subcutaneous fat in orbital, triceps regions and overlying the ribs; cachexia/sarcopenia: loss of temporalis, pectoralis, deltoids, interosseous muscles, latissimus dorsi, trapezius, quadriceps, gastrocnemius muscle mass; Muehrcke lines in nails suggest hypoalbuminemia, alopecia associated with protein deficiency, and scaling of scalp with essential fatty acid deficiency

normative_assertions.notes: Source-style suggestion to use CRP or neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio for inflammatory-state assessment.

text_units.verbatim_text: Albumin and prealbumin: these biomarkers have prognostic utility in HF, but though related to nutritional status, there is insufficient evidence that they change in response to nutritional interventions; C-reactive protein or neutrophil-lymphocyte ratio for inflammatory state assessment

text_units.verbatim_text: Hemoglobin, % iron saturation, and ferritin to screen for intravenous iron eligibility; United States Preventative Services Task force recommends against screening for vitamin D deficiency in asymptomatic adults

entities.surface_form: quick screening tool incorporating weight change, appetite, and supplementation

text_units.verbatim_text: Short Nutritional Assessment Questionnaire: http://www.fightmalnutrition.eu/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/SNAQ_Engels.jpg —quick screening tool incorporating weight change, appetite, and supplementation; unlike MUST and MNA (below), does not incorporate medical diagnoses or inpatient status Malnutrition Universal Screening Tool (MUST): https://www.bapen.org.uk/screening-and-must/must-calculator Mini Nutritional Assessment (MNA): https://www.mna-elderly.com/mna_forms.html

text_units.verbatim_text: Patient dietary intake self-collection and analysis can be performed on a mobile-health application such as MyFitnessPal for food record Predominantly research tools: inpatient nutrient intake analysis, daily food record or diary (typically at least 3–4 days), food frequency questionnaire: https://sharedresources.fredhutch.org/content/ffq-sample-booklets 24-hour recall https://epi.grants.cancer.gov/asa24/
